7: /** Start a session for a user and return it (the token is the bearer credential). */
8: export function createSession(userId: string): Session {
9:   const session: Session = { token: randomBytes(24).toString("base64url"), userId, createdAt: Date.now() };
10:   sessions.set(session.token, session);
11:   return session;
12: }
13: 
14: /** The live session for a token, or undefined. */
15: export function getSession(token: string): Session | undefined {
16:   return sessions.get(token);
17: }
18:
